newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends lower vs dlr at 1,085.15.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends lower vs dlr at 1,085.15.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended slightly lower against the dollar at 1,085.15 but well off a session low of 1,087.15, interbank dealers said.

"There was a little bit of speculating in the morning and volatilty at midday ... but it stabilized later on," one trader said of the seesaw session in which the peso finally settled just 0.15 centavos below Monday's close.
He said dollar sales by coffee and oil exporters, and rumors that a coal exporter was preparing to unload a large quantity of greenbacks, provided fundamental support for the peso.
Dealers reported 310 trades for a total of $154 million and said the peso's intraday high was 1,085.00.
